title: Fill Holes on the PAINT layer - Adjust's Fill button is mask-only
description: MpiToolOptionsMaskAdjust drops the Fill button on the paintAdjust destination (DEST.paintAdjust.fillHoles = false), so a closed outline drawn on the paint layer cannot be filled - the single most useful thing an outline tool can do. MaskManager.fillHoles() holds the only flood implementation. Extract the flood to a pure shared module (the distanceField.js precedent - one module, two destinations) and add PaintManager.fillHoles(), filling the enclosed region in the current paint colour with the original drawn back on top, exactly like Adjust's grow row.
